title: 补货优先级与供应商风险
context: 库存主管需要同时考虑销售速度、在途量与采购履约。
requirements: 期末，未来30天需求=近30天实际销售出库量；在途=未取消且承诺日严格晚于2025-12-31、且未完成采购的剩余数量；履约风险用对应商品历史采购准时足量率（承诺日已到且非取消），缺失NULL；对有效商品计算缺口、库存金额、供应商风险，按缺口降序。
commonError: 将已逾期未到货全部当作确定在途会掩盖风险。
executionSteps: 分别统计销售和采购履约
mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), p AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN promised_date>'2025-12-31' AND quantity_ordered>accepted THEN quantity_ordered-accepted ELSE 0 END) inbound,SUM(CASE WHEN promised_date<='2025-12-31' AND on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good,SUM(CASE WHEN promised_date<='2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) due FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), z AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,COALESCE(s.sold,0) demand,COALESCE(p.inbound,0) inbound,100.0*p.good/NULLIF(p.due,0) reliability FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products a ON a.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN p ON p.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND a.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,stock_value_cents,demand,inbound,demand-quantity-inbound shortage,ROUND(reliability,2) reliability_pct FROM z WHERE demand>quantity+inbound ORDER BY shortage DESC,warehouse_id,product_id
